claims: NASA is set to launch the Artemis II mission no earlier than 6:24 p.m. EDT on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Pad 39B.
The Artemis II mission will send four astronauts around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II mission utilizes the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission utilizes the Orion spacecraft.
